name: highlight-reel
description: A highlight reel built from your own photos and videos.

scripts.render: npm run scan && remotion render HighlightReel out/highlight-reel.mp4
scripts.render:square: npm run scan && remotion render HighlightReelSquare out/highlight-reel-square.mp4
scripts.render:wide: npm run scan && remotion render HighlightReelWide out/highlight-reel-wide.mp4
